# Agentic GraphRAG prototype

This prototype follows the Agentic GraphRAG Hackathon Round 1 brief: compare RAG, GraphRAG, and Agentic GraphRAG on the same questions, and record accuracy, evidence, steps, and token usage.

MCP integration uses the official Python SDK v2. See:

- https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk
- https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/

Run the MCP server with `python src/mcp_server.py` over stdio, or use the VS Code MCP configuration in `.vscode/mcp.json`.
